description_en: Queries the list of mountable file systems in a specified region
description_zh: 查询指定地域可挂载的文件系统列表
name: ListAvailableFileSystems

parameters.help_en: The current page number. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 当前页码。 起始值：1。 默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数。 取值范围：1~50。 默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the file system was created, in the format of YYYY-M-D HH:mm:ss. The month and day may not have leading zeros
CreateTime.description_zh: 文件系统创建时间，格式为 YYYY-M-D HH:mm:ss，月份和日期可以不补前导零

FileSystemType.description_en:
The file system type. Valid values:
standard: General-purpose NAS
extreme: Extreme NAS

<props="china">

cpfs: Cloud Parallel File Storage (CPFS)

</props>
FileSystemType.description_zh:
文件系统类型。可能值：
standard：通用型 NAS
extreme：极速型 NAS

<props="china">

cpfs：CPFS

</props>

MountTargetList.description_en: The list of mount targets for the file system

items.description_en: The file system mount target information

MountTargetDomain.description_en: The mount target address of the file system

NetworkType.description_en:
The network type. Valid values:
vpc: VPC
NetworkType.description_zh:
网络类型。可能值：
vpc：专有网络

Status.description_en:
The mount target status. Valid values:
Active: available
Inactive: unavailable
Pending: mounting
Deleting: being deleted
Status.description_zh:
挂载点状态。可能值：
Active：可用
Inactive：不可用
Pending：挂载中
Deleting：删除中

ProtocolType.description_en:
The protocol type of the file system. Valid values:
nfs
smb
cpfs
ProtocolType.description_zh:
文件系统的协议类型。可能值：
nfs
smb
cpfs

Status.description_en:
The file system status. Valid values:
Pending: The file system is processing a node.
Running: The file system is active. You can perform what to do next (such as creating mount targets) only when the status is Running.
Stopped: The file system is unavailable.
Extending: The file system is being scaled out.
Stopping: The file system is being stopped.
Deleting: The file system is being deleted
Status.description_zh:
文件系统状态。可能值：
Pending：当前文件系统正在处理任务中。
Running：当前文件系统可用，当状态为 Running 时才可以进行后续操作（例如：创建挂载点等）。
Stopped：当前文件系统不可用。
Extending：当前文件系统扩容中。
Stopping：当前文件系统停机中。
Deleting：当前文件系统删除中

StorageType.description_en:
The storage specification type.

If FileSystemType is standard, valid values: Capacity and Performance.
If FileSystemType is extreme, valid values: standard and advance.
<props="china">
If FileSystemType is CPFS, valid values: advance_100 (100 MB/s/TiB baseline) and advance_200 (200 MB/s/TiB baseline).</props>
StorageType.description_zh:
存储规格类型。

当FileSystemType为standard时，可能值：Capacity（容量型）、Performance（性能型）
当FileSystemType为extreme时，可能值：standard（标准型）、advance（高级型）
<props="china">
当FileSystemType为CPFS时，可能值：advance_100（100MB/s/TiB基线）、advance_200（200MB/s/TiB基线）</props>

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries on the current page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries in the list
